mod_knowledge_compare_meta: What changed between two versions of {name}: files, manifest and changelog.
mod_knowledge_compare_invalid: Choose two different versions of this mod.
mod_knowledge_diff_sizes_only: One of the archives was inspected without checksums, so files are compared by size only: a file that changed without changing size will not appear.
mod_knowledge_diff_truncated: The lists show the first {max} files of each group.
mod_knowledge_diff_unavailable: The file list of one of these versions is not available, so only the size, manifest and changelog are compared.
mod_knowledge_diff_changelog_empty: There are no releases between these two versions.
mod_knowledge_diff_changelog_none: No changelog was written for this version.
mod_knowledge_diff_changelog_truncated: Only the most recent releases in the range are shown.
mod_knowledge_editor_coauthor_text: You can release versions and edit the known issues and FAQ. The listing, media and status stay with {owner}.
mod_knowledge_issues_hint: Problems you know about. They show on the mod page; mark them fixed when a version solves them.
mod_knowledge_issues_empty: No known issues. Add one if players should know about a problem.
mod_knowledge_issue_affects_hint: Free text, for example “1.2.0 and older”.
mod_knowledge_faq_hint: Questions players ask often. Your answers appear on the mod page above the automatic ones and are included in search results.
mod_knowledge_faq_empty: No questions yet. Add the ones you keep answering.
mod_knowledge_team_hint: Co-authors appear on the mod page and their profile. They can release versions and edit the known issues and FAQ.
mod_knowledge_team_handle_hint: The person receives a notification and must accept.
mod_knowledge_team_full: A mod can have up to {max} co-authors, including pending invitations.
mod_knowledge_invites_intro: Accept to release versions and edit the known issues and FAQ of these mods.
mod_knowledge_invites_accepted: You are now a co-author of {mod}
mod_knowledge_invites_empty_text: When a creator invites you to co-author a mod, it shows up here.
mod_knowledge_shared_none: You have no mods shared with you yet.
